def actual_executable(raw, package_id, target_name, target_kind, source_path, test):
    records = []
    for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        item = json.loads(line)
        if item.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and item.get('package_id') == package_id and \
                item.get('target', {}).get('name') == target_name and item.get('executable'):
            require(item['target']['kind'] == [target_kind] and
                    item['target']['src_path'] == str(source_path) and
                    item['profile']['test'] is test,
                    'Cargo executable has a wrong target/source/profile')
            profile = item['profile']
            require('debuginfo' in profile and profile.get('opt_level') == '3' and
                    profile.get('debug_assertions') is False and
                    profile.get('overflow_checks') is False and
                    (profile.get('debuginfo') is None or
                     type(profile['debuginfo']) is int and profile['debuginfo'] == 0),
                    'actual selected executable is not the original workspace default release profile')
            records.append((Path(item['executable']), dict(profile)))
    require(len(records) == 1, 'expected actual executable missing or duplicate')
    path, profile = records[0]
    require(path.is_relative_to(OUT/'cargo-target/release') and '..' not in path.parts,
            'actual executable escaped the fresh owned release Cargo target')
    real_directory(path.parent)
    data, pin = held(path, 128*1024*1024)
    require(len(data) >= 64 and data[:6] == b'\x7fELF\x02\x01' and
            int.from_bytes(data[16:18], 'little') in (2, 3) and
            int.from_bytes(data[18:20], 'little') == 62 and pin['identity'][2] & 0o111,
            'actual release executable is not an executable regular x86_64 ELF64')
    return path, pin, profile
